cron._comment: Documentation only — nothing reads these at runtime. The real schedule is Supabase pg_cron (supabase/migrations/010_supabase_cron_scheduler.sql — cron.job table, jobs render-health-ping/render-morning/render-eod/render-remind/render-cleanup), which calls these exact times directly via pg_net. The .github/workflows/*.yml files still exist as redundant backup triggers (harmless, everything here is idempotency-guarded) but are no longer the primary source — they were unreliable under GitHub's shared scheduler, see those files' comments.
